title: Delivery-Record Ceiling from Tailwise Autoship History for Tailwise Pharmacy Diet Orders
content:
*Autoship billing desk note.*

The days' supply per fill of a new Tailwise Pharmacy prescription diet order placed for a pet whose diet another household pet already takes is no more than the delivery-record ceiling. The delivery-record ceiling reads the customer's Tailwise Autoship ledger, across all of the customer's Autoship subscriptions, over the 6 calendar months ending on the order date: the shipment charges booked and the Autoship payments declined.

| Autoship shipments charged in the 6 calendar months | Autoship payments declined in that period | Delivery-record ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | none | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | none | 45 days: the 30-day new-order days' supply plus 15 days |
| none | none | 30 days |
| any | one or more | 30 days |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; order dated 2026-09-10)

- Shipment charges on 2026-04-02, 2026-05-30 and 2026-08-01, no declined payment: class maximum.
- The same three charges and one declined payment on 2026-06-28: 30 days.
- Two shipment charges in the period, no declined payment: 45 days.
- Shipment charges only in January 2026, outside the 6 months: 30 days.
